hypothesis.statement: A regime-transition defensive mechanism provides independent, cost-aware opportunities in the post-transition window where the current legacy universe has insufficient or poor coverage (gap: REGIME TRANSITION / CORRECTION, INSUFFICIENT_OBSERVATION per REGIME_COVERAGE_GAP_REPORT.md).
hypothesis.direction_rule: Trade ONLY the direction the NEW canonical regime state implies, deterministically: stress in {CORRECTION, SHOCK} -> SHORT; trend_direction == BULL and market_structure == BREAKOUT -> LONG; otherwise NO_TRADE. Direction is never derived from the raw impulse bar, never from LLM output, never broadened into generic momentum/trend after seeing data.
hypothesis.orthogonality_claim: Adds a regime state variable conditioning the entry window; legacy momentum was never evaluated conditionally on transitions.

transition_identity.qualifying_transition: state[t-1] != state[t] (six-dim key change) AND at least one of: (volatility in {NORMAL, LOW} -> {HIGH, EXTREME}) OR (stress NORMAL -> {CORRECTION, SHOCK}) OR (market_structure in {TREND, RANGE} -> TRANSITION)
transition_identity.transition_bar: first 1h bar t whose state key differs from state[t-1]; decision_time = close_time of bar t; entry = open of bar t+1

universe.data_source: binanceusdm public REST /fapi/v1/klines (same provider authority already frozen for POC02)

entry_exit.entry: market at open of bar t+1 after transition bar close (t)
entry_exit.cooldown: one open position per asset at a time; no re-entry until exit
entry_exit.stop_loss: entry +/- ATR(14) of the trailing 14 completed 1h bars ending at t (direction-adjusted)
entry_exit.pessimistic_fill: if stop and time exit fall in the same bar, the stop is assumed first
entry_exit.exit_fill: stop level intrabar, else close of the time-exit bar

cost_model.cost_basis: identical to CARRY-FUNDING-DEEP-01 preregistered cost (5 bps per side); sensitivity reported at 5 and 20 bps RT

minimum_n.primary_cell_definition: asset x direction pooled across transitions (3 assets x 2 directions)

robustness.halves: first half vs second half of trade sequence, net R sign
robustness.thirds: three equal chronological thirds, net R sign

permutation.method: shuffle trade R sequence signs of entry order vs realized cumulative path

robustness.monte_carlo_dd: bootstrap trade sequence, 95th percentile max drawdown in R
robustness.slippage: recompute net expectancy at 5 and 20 bps RT

orthogonality_test.legacy_proxy: ROC(24)-breakout momentum on the same 1h bars (long when ROC24 > +2%, short when ROC24 < -2%, same entry/exit/cost mechanics)
metrics: PnL correlation over calendar-day aggregated R where both active
orthogonality_test.redundant_candidate_rule: trade-time overlap > 0.6 AND pnl_correlation > 0.7 -> REDUNDANT_CANDIDATE even if raw PF attractive

metrics: incremental opportunities/day (transition events outside legacy-proxy active windows)
opportunities during NO_SIGNAL / AGENT_FILTER / idle periods (from R2 regime attribution where available)
frequency_value.constraint: Do NOT tune for >=3/day; report only.

pit_semantics.regime_at_t: uses only bars with close_time <= decision_time
pit_semantics.signal_at_t: uses only bars with close_time <= decision_time
pit_semantics.entry_at_t: open of the NEXT bar after decision_time
pit_semantics.future_mutation_invariant: changing any candle after decision_time must not change past regime, transition, signal, or trade decision (enforced by unit test)

execution_discipline.exactly_once_marker: docs/external-audit-01/h1-regime-transition-01/H1_EXECUTION_MARKER.json written BEFORE result artifacts; runner refuses a second economic run
execution_discipline.technical_replay_allowed: deterministic replay permitted for verification; flagged technical_replay=true and never counted as a second experiment
execution_discipline.confirmation_usage: CONF-EDGE-002-001 untouched; this research neither reads nor uses the confirmation window

must_not_reuse: legacy momentum unconditional (14 FAILED retro cells)
failed_memory_check.distinction: H1 is a transition-STATE conditional entry with regime-implied direction and time-boxed horizon; it reuses no failed threshold, no funding signal, no cross-sectional ranking, and no unconditional momentum trigger. Orthogonality is measured, not assumed.

protocol.pipeline: fetch klines -> validate (monotonic, uniform, no gaps > 1h tolerated by gap-fill skip) -> derive state[t] for t >= 200 -> detect qualifying transitions -> apply direction rule -> simulate trades with frozen entry/exit/cost -> compute B1 metrics -> B2 orthogonality -> B3 frequency -> classify B4 -> write results
protocol.reporting: overall + by asset + by direction + by transition class (preregistered identity components)
